question.explanation: NASA launched 135 Space Shuttle missions from 1981 to 2011 using Columbia, Challenger, Discovery, Atlantis and Endeavour. Each flown STS designation counts separately; each orbiter name also counts as one answer. Unflown rescue missions and Enterprise's atmospheric tests are excluded.

provenance.brief: Name a Space Shuttle mission (by its STS designation or its orbiter name).

quotes.STS-107: STS-107 | Columbia | 7 | 15d 22h | LC-39A | Did not land
